name: rco-landingpages
description: Landing pages da RCO Hub num domínio só (lp.rcohub.com.br): formulário (/), /lp01 (P05), /lp02 (P04, desligada), /lp-ecom (reservada). Leads seguem para o COMERCIAL-RCO.

scripts.build: npm run build:form && npm run build -w @rco/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @rco/web && npm run lint --prefix formulario
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run typecheck --prefix formulario
